parameters.name: AlertState
parameters.description:
The status of the alert rule. Valid values:
- OK: Normal.
- ALARM: Alert.
- INSUFFICIENT_DATA: No data.

parameters.name: Dimensions
parameters.description:
The monitoring dimensions of the specified resource.

Format: A collection of `key:value` pairs, for example, `{"userId":"120886317861****"}` and `{"instanceId":"i-2ze2d6j5uhg20x47****"}`.

parameters.name: EnableState
parameters.description:
The enabled state of the alert rule. Valid values:
- true: Enabled.
- false: Disabled.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the application group.

For information about how to obtain the application group ID, see [DescribeMonitorGroups](~~115032~~).

parameters.name: MetricName
parameters.description:
The metric name.

For information about how to obtain metric names, see [DescribeMetricMetaList](~~98846~~) or [Cloud service metrics](~~163515~~).

Note: For composite metrics, you can only search by the first metric.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description:
The namespace of the cloud service.

For information about how to obtain the namespace of a cloud service, see [DescribeMetricMetaList](~~98846~~) or [Cloud service metrics](~~163515~~).

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description:
The page number.

Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page.

Minimum value: 1. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RuleIds
parameters.description: The IDs of alert rules. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can query up to 20 alert rules at a time.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description:
The name of the alert rule.

This parameter supports fuzzy search.
